title: The DevOps Tax: Why Your Platform is Failing
description:
Developers are drowning in Kubernetes, pipelines and compliance checklists instead of shipping features. This episode is for engineering leaders and platform teams who want to understand the DevOps tax and replace it with platform engineering, from golden paths and policy as code to Team Topologies, measurement and AI-ready governance.
In this episode
00:00 – The DevOps tax defined03:19 – How DevOps broke at scale06:42 – The cognitive load crisis and shadow IT16:25 – DevOps versus platform engineering20:18 – Golden paths, infrastructure as code and policy as code31:12 – Team Topologies and the platform product mindset41:16 – Measurement, developer experience and AI governance64:31 – Migration path, ROI and objections
Key takeaways
The DevOps tax is the hidden cost of making every team run its own infrastructure at scale, paid in cognitive load, tool sprawl, shadow IT and burnout.Platform engineering inverts the model: a platform team treats infrastructure as a product and offers golden paths built on infrastructure as code and policy as code.Success is measured by voluntary adoption, developer experience, DORA metrics and reduced cognitive load, and the same embedded governance lets AI agents such as Copilot operate safely.
Worth quoting
“The DevOps promise didn't fail because the idea was wrong. It failed because it scaled wrong.” – Mirko Peters (00:44)
“A golden path is an opinionated pre-built workflow that handles the 80% of use cases that are actually common, not all use cases, not every possible variation.” – Mirko Peters (20:33)
Explore more on M365.FM
